response.answer: Janet Holmes is a New Zealand sociolinguist known for her work on gendered language in telephone conversations, focusing on lexical, grammatical, and pragmatic variation through corpus-based research. She is Emeritus Professor of Linguistics at Victoria University of Wellington and a Fellow of the Royal Society of New Zealand.
